## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 460 captures during March 2022. This records the imaging activity undertaken at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The activity is reported against the site’s routine operational measures, with the results set out below for review.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.0 per cent. This measure identifies the proportion of images that could not be used for grading. The result provides an indication of the overall usability of the images submitted by North City Eye Clinic during March 2022.

## Grading

There were 93 referable results. The median grading wait was 17 days. Together, these measures describe the grading outcome and the time taken for results to progress through grading. The figures provide a summary of grading performance for the 460 captures completed during March 2022, alongside the image-quality result reported above.
